question: I would like to know the given names of baseball players who have achieved the highest value of games played, runs, hits, and home runs, with their corresponding score values.
sql: SELECT p.name_given, b.player_id, TRY_CAST(b.g AS INTEGER) as g, TRY_CAST(b.r AS INTEGER) as r, TRY_CAST(b.h AS INTEGER) as h, TRY_CAST(b.hr AS INTEGER) as hr FROM batting b JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id WHERE (b.player_id = 'willsma01' AND TRY_CAST(b.g AS INTEGER) = 165) OR (b.player_id = 'hamilbi01' AND TRY_CAST(b.r AS INTEGER) = 192) OR (b.player_id = 'suzukic01' AND TRY_CAST(b.h AS INTEGER) = 262) OR (b.player_id = 'bondsba01' AND TRY_CAST(b.hr AS INTEGER) = 73)
